name: TMS OS V14.2.2
notes: Sua 3 loi giao dien V14.2.0: app.js co loi SyntaxError (khai bao setRelative trung) lam menu va nut cai app khong bam duoc; logo header mat (path icon sai) da sua; PWA icon co vien trang da thay bang icon solid day nen (icon-192/512-solid.png) trong manifest va khi doi logo.
features: One-touch update in panel: downloads latest release from GitHub, backs up, swaps, health-checks, rolls back on failure
One-command self-update API /api/updates/run with per-install token (scripts and automation safe)
Safe rollback: only uses backups containing app+public+config; flash messages survive target swap via flash.json
Installer hardened: RAM/disk pre-check before MariaDB (suggests SQLite on weak devices), php-zip check, repair skips account setup, stronger pkg retry
